scope: Recommendations from completed screens, without changing historical controls, gates, weights or STOP decisions.

base_control.role: Ordinary calibrated five-view detections; highest AR500 among these discussed controls.

ordinary_coordinate_control.selection: Original fixed seed0, not best-seed selection after the repeat.
ordinary_coordinate_control.inference: Frozen calibration -> six prediction-only actions -> ActionScorer uniform -> select_actions(..., absolute), margin0.01 -> coordinates only. No GT input.

regret_candidate.role: Small extra AP signal, with AR500 loss versus ordinary uniform. Same seed0 convention.

research_judgment: Do not abandon small-object detection based on these screens. Keep the fixed coordinate-ranking task as an engineering/research baseline, stop treating current loss shapes or standard consensus as established originality. Further training needs a specific new observable signal and matched closer controls; same viewed test-dev and three head seeds are not independent-data or detector-seed proof.
